metadata.title: BGA — board game rules assistant
metadata.description: A local voice assistant that teaches board game rules from your own rulebooks.

home.title: Board game rules assistant
home.subtitle: Answers come only from the rulebooks, FAQs and errata indexed on this computer.

engineOffline.title: The RAG engine is not responding
engineOffline.body: Start it with <command>pnpm dev</command> in the repository directory. The interface works, but without the engine there is nowhere to get the rules from.

game.label: Game
game.description: Retrieval is always scoped to a single game

question.label: Question
question.placeholder: Can I play an action card if I have no tiles left?

insufficientEvidence.title: No basis in the documents
insufficientEvidence.body: This answer is not covered by the indexed material. Add an errata or a FAQ for this game rather than treating the text above as a rule.

error.title: Engine error
error.unknown: The engine reported an error that has no description here yet.
error.engine_unreachable: Could not reach the local RAG engine.
error.stream_truncated: The answer stream stopped before it finished.
error.http_error: The engine responded with an error.
error.malformed_frame: The engine sent a frame that is not valid JSON.
error.unknown_event: The engine sent a frame that does not match the event contract.

notice.unknown: The engine reported a state that has no description here yet.
notice.engine_not_indexed:
No documents are indexed for “{{gameId}}” yet, so there is nothing to base a rules answer on.

The engine is running and streaming works — what is missing is the retrieval step (stage 3 of the plan). Active model profile: {{profile}}.

setup.title: First-run setup
setup.subtitle: We check this computer and recommend a model profile. Page citation quality is the same on every profile — smaller machines only trade fluency for speed.

browserOnly.title: Running in the browser
browserOnly.body: This screen is meant for the desktop app. In the browser, start the stack with pnpm dev as usual.

profile.sharedRetrieval: Search and reranking models are identical on every profile, so the cited rulebook page stays equally accurate.
profile.diskNeed: About {{gib}} GB of disk will be used after models are downloaded.

minimal-16gb.title: Recommended: minimal (16 GB class)
minimal-16gb.body: A smaller language model. Answers stay grounded in the same pages, but wording is simpler, teaching is weaker, and “I don’t know” appears more often.

starter-32gb.title: Recommended: starter (32 GB class)
starter-32gb.body: The default build profile. Good balance of speed and explanation quality for settling rules at the table.

full-64gb.title: Recommended: full (64 GB class)
full-64gb.body: Largest local models, including an optional vision model later. Best fluency for teaching a new game out loud.

reason.full: This machine has enough memory for the full profile.
reason.starter: This machine matches the starter profile.
reason.minimal: This machine fits the minimal profile comfortably.
reason.insufficient_disk: Free disk space is low for the recommended profile. Free space before downloading models.
reason.insufficient_memory: Memory is below the comfortable minimum. The minimal profile is still offered, but answers may be slow or truncated.

ollama.missingBody: The language models run through Ollama on this computer. Install it, start it once, then reopen this app.

models.title: Model download
models.body: Models are downloaded with a visible progress step so the app never looks frozen. The installer itself stays small; the weights are several gigabytes.

diagnostics.saved: Saved to {{path}}. Send that file if something breaks — nothing is uploaded automatically.

pdfImport.title: Add a rulebook PDF
pdfImport.subtitle: You always load your own PDFs. Nothing from someone else’s library is bundled.

gameId.label: Game id
gameId.description: Lowercase slug used as the folder name, for example azul or brass-birmingham

drop.title: Drop a PDF here
drop.body: Drag a publisher rulebook onto this area. Indexing is stage 2 of the roadmap — until then the app explains that ingest is not ready yet.

error.invalidGameIdBody: Use a lowercase slug: letters, digits and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit.
error.ingestNotReadyBody: Received “{{fileName}}”, but document ingestion (stage 2) is not implemented. The file was not copied and no index was built.
error.browserOnlyBody: Dragging a real file path needs the desktop shell. In the browser, wait for the stage 2 CLI, or open the Electron app.
